answers.sql: SELECT h1.amount_million - q2.amount_million AS value FROM expenses h1 JOIN expenses q2 ON 1=1 WHERE h1.entity='Tesla' AND h1.period='H1' AND h1.year=2024 AND h1.metric='R&D' AND q2.entity='Tesla' AND q2.period='Q2' AND q2.year=2024 AND q2.metric='R&D'

SELECT (q2.amount_million - (h1.amount_million - q2.amount_million)) * 100.0 / (h1.amount_million - q2.amount_million) AS value FROM expenses h1 JOIN expenses q2 ON 1=1 WHERE h1.entity='Tesla' AND h1.period='H1' AND h1.year=2024 AND h1.metric='R&D' AND q2.entity='Tesla' AND q2.period='Q2' AND q2.year=2024 AND q2.metric='R&D'
